tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Cudy M1200 AC1200 Dual Band Mesh WiFi Router (1 Pack) | Seamless Whole Home Coverage with Fast, Reliable Internet


Experience stable, high-speed internet across your entire home with the Cudy M1200 AC1200 Mesh WiFi Router. This dual band mesh router delivers speeds up to 1200Mbps (300Mbps on 2.4GHz + 867Mbps on 5GHz), ensuring smooth 4K streaming, online gaming, and lag-free browsing on multiple devices.

With mesh technology, the M1200 eliminates Wi-Fi dead zones by intelligently distributing strong signals throughout your home. It’s perfect for medium to large homes, offering seamless roaming, fast handoff, and easy network expansion with additional Cudy mesh units.

Key Features:

  • Dual Band AC1200 Speed: 300Mbps (2.4GHz) + 867Mbps (5GHz)
  • Mesh Technology: Expandable whole-home WiFi coverage
  • Seamless Roaming: Auto-connects to the strongest signal
  • Supports up to 60 devices: Great for smart homes and families
  • Easy Setup via App: Quick configuration and network management
  • Compact & Modern Design: Fits anywhere in your home
